```{python}
#| label: fig-layout-antenna
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The antenna effect and its fixes (cross sections): (a) a long `M1` wire connected to a gate collects charge during plasma etching and can destroy the gate oxide; (b) breaking the `M1` wire and bridging with `M2` limits the charge collected while `M1` is etched; (c) an antenna diode drains the collected charge harmlessly into the substrate."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Polygon

C = dict(sub='#f5e9d0', ox='#c7dff2', poly='#3e9c5c', metal='#8f8f8f',
         m2='#5e5e5e', nplus='#4a7fb5')

def base(ax, title):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), 12, 1.5, fc=C['sub'], ec='k', lw=0.8))
    # gate stack
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.0, 1.5), 1.0, 0.12, fc=C['ox'], ec='k',
                           lw=0.4))
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.0, 1.62), 1.0, 0.4, fc=C['poly'], ec='k',
                           lw=0.5))
    ax.text(1.5, 0.75, 'MOSFET\ngate', ha='center', fontsize=7)
    # contact to M1
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.4, 2.02), 0.25, 0.5, fc=C['metal'], ec='k',
                           lw=0.4))
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=9, loc='left')
    ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 12.2)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.2, 4.6)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.axis('off')

fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(7, 6.2))

# (a) violation
ax = axs[0]
base(ax, '(a) antenna violation: large metal area tied to the gate')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.0, 2.52), 10.5, 0.4, fc=C['metal'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.6))
ax.text(6.5, 3.6, 'charge collected during plasma etching',
        fontsize=8, ha='center', color='#8000c0')
for x in [4, 6, 8, 10]:
    ax.text(x, 3.15, '+', fontsize=10, color='#8000c0', ha='center')

# (b) M2 bridge
ax = axs[1]
base(ax, '(b) fix: break M1 and bridge with M2')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.0, 2.52), 1.6, 0.4, fc=C['metal'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.4, 2.52), 8.1, 0.4, fc=C['metal'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.6))
# vias and M2 bridge
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.2, 2.92), 0.25, 0.5, fc=C['m2'], ec='k', lw=0.4))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.6, 2.92), 0.25, 0.5, fc=C['m2'], ec='k', lw=0.4))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((2.0, 3.42), 2.1, 0.4, fc=C['m2'], ec='k', lw=0.6))
ax.text(3.05, 4.1, 'M2 bridge', fontsize=8, ha='center')

# (c) antenna diode
ax = axs[2]
base(ax, '(c) fix: antenna diode drains the charge')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.0, 2.52), 10.5, 0.4, fc=C['metal'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.6))
# diode: n+ diffusion connected to the wire
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((9.4, 1.1), 1.2, 0.4, fc=C['nplus'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.5))
ax.text(10.0, 1.3, '$n^+$', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
        color='white')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((9.85, 1.5), 0.25, 1.02, fc=C['metal'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.4))
ax.text(10.9, 1.7, 'antenna\ndiode', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
